tagline: 佳能便携相机，1984 年发布
description: 佳能于1984年推出的便携相机。配备35mm, f/2.8 (4 elements in 4 groups).。快门速度1/8-1/500s.。

specs.英文简介: The MC (micro compact) range consisted of two 35mm compact camera models, the high-end autofocus Canon MC, introduced in April 1984 (QD version also available) and the fixed focus MC10 of March 1985.
